context: The agent is given a git repository where the /users/list endpoint has been renamed to /users/index in the api/ module and staged. The commit is a breaking change confined to the api scope. The agent must review the staged diff, write a commit message with a scoped prefix and a body explaining the breaking change, and save it to commit-message.txt.

checklist.name: Parenthesised scope format
checklist.description: The subject line of commit-message.txt contains a scope in parentheses between the type and the colon — e.g. type(scope): — not just a plain type: prefix

checklist.name: Correct scope name
checklist.description: The scope in the subject line identifies the api component (i.e. the parenthesised value is 'api' or similar, not a generic or unrelated label)

checklist.name: Commit body present
checklist.description: commit-message.txt has at least one non-empty line after a blank line that follows the subject — a body section is present

checklist.name: Body explains breaking nature
checklist.description: The body text references the breaking or incompatible nature of the change — e.g. uses at least one of: 'breaking', 'break', 'callers', 'clients', 'incompatible', 'old path', 'migration', 'backward'

checklist.name: Subject ≤50 characters
checklist.description: The subject line (first line) of commit-message.txt is no longer than 50 characters

checklist.name: Conventional commit type
checklist.description: The subject line begins with a recognised conventional commit type (feat, fix, refactor, chore, docs, ci, perf, build, or test) before the optional scope and colon

checklist.name: Lowercase subject
checklist.description: The subject line is written in lowercase (the description part after the colon does not begin with a capital letter)

checklist.name: No trailing punctuation
checklist.description: The subject line does NOT end with a full stop, exclamation mark, or question mark

checklist.name: Active voice subject
checklist.description: The subject line uses active voice — the commit is the implied actor (e.g. 'renames', 'updates', 'changes') and does NOT use passive constructions (e.g. 'was renamed', 'is updated')

checklist.name: Body adds new information
checklist.description: The body does NOT merely restate the subject line — it provides additional context, rationale, or impact details beyond what the subject says
